player.name: Yash Sarda
player.title: Software Engineer
player.summary: Software engineer with hands-on full-stack experience. Strong in problem-solving and programming, focused on building practical, real-world software that delivers measurable impact.

ballByBall: Improving the sanctions compliance system that keeps restricted people and entities in line with each country's law.
Supporting 200+ country-specific sanctions lists for global regulatory adherence.
Designed Excel bulk upload: 10,000+ records validated per upload across 50+ fields — manual entry down 60%.
Shipped dashboard features end-to-end; 75+ JUnit tests raised coverage and cut production defects.
Built a Kudo Board platform from the ground up to celebrate individual and team wins for 10,000+ employees.
Drove engagement with 4+ interaction types — messages, GIFs, short videos and gesture-based responses.
Enabled personalised delivery so recognition lands with the right person or team.

matchHighlights.name: AI Interview Grooming Platform
matchHighlights.line: A conversational AI interviewer that asks real follow-ups and scores you at the end.
matchHighlights.serve: Interview practice rarely feels real — no follow-up questions, no honest score.
matchHighlights.rally: Google Gemini generates questions, asks follow-ups based on your answers and evaluates them. React client, Node.js server, Firebase for auth and real-time data.
matchHighlights.winner: An end-of-interview score and feedback — and a paper published in a journal.

matchHighlights.name: Kudo Board
matchHighlights.line: A recognition platform celebrating individual and team wins for 10,000+ employees.
matchHighlights.serve: Recognition across a 10,000+ person organisation was scattered and generic.
matchHighlights.rally: Built from the ground up with 4+ interaction types — messages, GIFs, short videos and gesture-based responses.
matchHighlights.winner: Personalised delivery to the right person or team, across 10,000+ employees.

matchHighlights.name: Power BI Dashboard
matchHighlights.line: An analytics-driven web platform with interactive Power BI dashboards embedded inside it.
matchHighlights.serve: Teams needed live, interactive Power BI reports inside their own web platform — not in a separate tool.
matchHighlights.rally: REST-based Embedding API, with server-side logic for session management, dashboard embedding and token generation.
matchHighlights.winner: Interactive reports that work in both desktop and mobile layouts.
